options.content:
## COPY · Conviction
Single-wallet accumulation trigger. HALTED manually 2026-08-05 (entry gate being redesigned).  
*Stat strip = current era (since the strategy's last reset). Charts and tables follow the time picker. Blue markers = logged changes, red = halts. Open positions with current liquidity < $100 are marked **RUG at −100%**.*

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT 'HALTED · ' || halt_type FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy_conviction' AND resumed_at IS NULL ORDER BY halted_at DESC LIMIT 1), 'running') AS state

panels.title: Era start

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(min(entry_at) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS era FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction'

panels.description: First trade under the strategy's current tag (resets re-tag older trades).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction'
SELECT ROUND(avg(pnl_usd)::numeric, 2) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction'
SELECT ROUND(avg((pnl_usd > 0)::int) * 100, 1) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction'
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(sum(pnl_usd), 0)::numeric, 0) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction'

panels.title: Open P&L

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT t.id, t.asset, t.entry_at, t.sim_metadata->>'strategy' AS strategy,
    COALESCE(t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet', t.sim_metadata->>'team_id', '') AS who,
    (t.sim_metadata->>'peak_pct_since_entry')::numeric AS peak_pct,
    (t.sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric AS el,
    COALESCE((t.sim_metadata->>'remaining_size_usd')::numeric, t.size_usd::numeric) AS rem,
    t.entry_price::numeric AS ep, l.liquidity_usd::numeric AS liq, l.price::numeric AS px, l.logged_at,
    CASE WHEN l.logged_at IS NULL THEN 'NO DATA'
         WHEN l.liquidity_usd < 100 THEN 'RUG'
         WHEN l.logged_at < now() - interval '2 hours' THEN 'STALE'
         WHEN (t.sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric > 0
              AND l.liquidity_usd < 0.2 * (t.sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric
              THEN 'LIQ COLLAPSED'
         ELSE 'ok' END AS status
  FROM trades t
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT liquidity_usd, price, logged_at FROM position_liquidity_log p
                     WHERE p.trade_id = t.id ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true
  WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.fill_status='open' AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy' IN ('conviction')
), ou AS (
  SELECT o.*, CASE WHEN status='RUG' THEN -rem
                   WHEN px IS NOT NULL AND ep > 0 THEN rem * (px / ep - 1) END AS unreal
  FROM o) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(sum(unreal), 0), 0) FROM ou

panels.description: Unrealized P&L of open positions; liquidity < $100 counts as a rug at -100%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(entry_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction'

panels.title: Rolling expectancy — avg $ per trade over last 30 trades

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT exit_at AS time, sim_metadata->>'strategy' AS metric,
    AVG(pnl_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY sim_metadata->>'strategy' ORDER BY exit_at
                       ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value
  FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL
    AND sim_metadata->>'strategy' IN ('conviction')) x
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Above the grey line = making money per trade right now. Blue markers = changes, red = halts.

panels.title: P&L per trade — distribution & tail (time range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT pnl_usd, pnl_pct FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction' AND $__timeFilter(exit_at)),
tot AS (SELECT count(*) n FROM c)
SELECT substr(b, 3) AS bucket, count(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF(max(tot.n), 0), 0) AS share_pct,
  ROUND(sum(pnl_usd)::numeric, 0) AS net_usd
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN pnl_pct <= -90 THEN '1 <= -90% (rug-like)' WHEN pnl_pct <= -50 THEN '2 -90..-50%'
                  WHEN pnl_pct <= -20 THEN '3 -50..-20%' WHEN pnl_pct < 0 THEN '4 -20..0%'
                  WHEN pnl_pct < 20 THEN '5 0..+20%' WHEN pnl_pct < 100 THEN '6 +20..+100%'
                  WHEN pnl_pct < 400 THEN '7 +100..+400%' ELSE '8 >= +400%' END AS b, pnl_usd FROM c) x, tot
GROUP BY b ORDER BY b

panels.description: Where the money is made and lost. If net_usd is carried by the top buckets, the strategy is tail-dependent.

panels.title: Why trades close — exit reason × hold × P&L (time range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(exit_reason, '?') AS exit_reason, count(*) AS n,
  ROUND(avg((pnl_usd > 0)::int) * 100) AS win_pct, ROUND(avg(pnl_usd)::numeric, 1) AS exp_usd,
  ROUND(sum(pnl_usd)::numeric, 0) AS net_usd,
  ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM exit_at - entry_at) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS med_hold_h
FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction' AND $__timeFilter(exit_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

panels.title: Entry conditions vs outcome — are we entering late? (time range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT pnl_usd, (sim_metadata->>'token_age_at_entry_hours')::float AS age,
         (sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::float AS liq
  FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction' AND $__timeFilter(exit_at)),
b AS (
  SELECT 'A token age' AS factor, CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN '9 unknown' WHEN age < 0.25 THEN '1 <15m'
      WHEN age < 1 THEN '2 15m-1h' WHEN age < 6 THEN '3 1-6h' WHEN age < 24 THEN '4 6-24h'
      WHEN age < 168 THEN '5 1-7d' ELSE '6 >7d' END AS bk, pnl_usd FROM c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'B entry liquidity', CASE WHEN liq IS NULL THEN '9 unknown' WHEN liq < 10000 THEN '1 <$10k'
      WHEN liq < 50000 THEN '2 $10-50k' WHEN liq < 250000 THEN '3 $50-250k'
      WHEN liq < 1000000 THEN '4 $250k-1M' ELSE '5 >$1M' END, pnl_usd FROM c)
SELECT substr(factor, 3) AS factor, substr(bk, 3) AS bucket, count(*) AS n,
  ROUND(avg((pnl_usd > 0)::int) * 100) AS win_pct, ROUND(avg(pnl_usd)::numeric, 1) AS exp_usd,
  ROUND(sum(pnl_usd)::numeric, 0) AS net_usd
FROM b GROUP BY factor, bk ORDER BY factor, bk

panels.title: Did each change help? — 14 days before vs since (until next change)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(c.changed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS changed, c.kind, c.description,
  b.n AS n_before, b.e AS exp_before_usd, a.n AS n_after, a.e AS exp_after_usd,
  ROUND(a.e - b.e, 1) AS delta_exp_usd
FROM strategy_changes c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) n, ROUND(avg(t.pnl_usd)::numeric, 1) e FROM trades t
  WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.fill_status='closed' AND t.mode IN ('paper','archived') AND (t.sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction' OR t.sim_metadata->>'strategy' LIKE 'conviction\_pre\_reset%') AND t.entry_at >= c.changed_at - interval '14 days' AND t.entry_at < c.changed_at) b ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) n, ROUND(avg(t.pnl_usd)::numeric, 1) e FROM trades t
  WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.fill_status='closed' AND t.mode IN ('paper','archived') AND (t.sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction' OR t.sim_metadata->>'strategy' LIKE 'conviction\_pre\_reset%') AND t.entry_at >= c.changed_at
    AND t.entry_at < COALESCE((SELECT min(c2.changed_at) FROM strategy_changes c2
                               WHERE c2.strategy IN ('conviction','fleet') AND c2.changed_at > c.changed_at), now())) a ON true
WHERE c.strategy IN ('conviction','fleet') ORDER BY c.changed_at DESC

panels.description: Expectancy per trade for trades ENTERED in the 14 days before each logged change vs after it. Log changes with scripts/log_change.py.

panels.title: Net P&L per trigger wallet — (n) = trades (time range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LEFT(t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet', 6) || ' (' || count(*) || ')' AS label,
  ROUND(sum(t.pnl_usd)::numeric, 0) AS net_usd
FROM trades t WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.fill_status='closed' AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction' AND $__timeFilter(t.exit_at) AND t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet' ORDER BY net_usd DESC

panels.title: P&L by trigger wallet (time range) — the cull lever

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet' AS wallet, COALESCE(wp.tier, '?') AS tier,
  COALESCE(ws.cls, '?') AS style, count(*) AS n, ROUND(sum(t.pnl_usd)::numeric, 0) AS net_usd,
  ROUND(avg(t.pnl_usd)::numeric, 1) AS exp_usd, ROUND(avg((t.pnl_usd > 0)::int) * 100) AS win_pct,
  CASE WHEN count(*) >= 5 AND sum(t.pnl_usd) < 0 THEN 'demote?' ELSE '' END AS flag
FROM trades t
LEFT JOIN wallet_pool wp ON wp.address = t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet'
LEFT JOIN wallet_style ws ON ws.address = t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet'
WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.fill_status='closed' AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction' AND $__timeFilter(t.exit_at) AND t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY net_usd DESC

panels.description: 'demote?' = at least 5 trades and net negative. Advisory — you decide.

panels.title: P&L by wallet style — sniper / MM / selector (time range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(ws.cls, 'UNCLASSIFIED') AS style, count(DISTINCT t.id) AS trades,
  ROUND(sum(t.pnl_usd / json_array_length(t.sim_metadata->'cluster_wallets'))::numeric, 0) AS attributed_net_usd,
  ROUND((sum(t.pnl_usd / json_array_length(t.sim_metadata->'cluster_wallets')) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT t.id), 0))::numeric, 1) AS exp_usd
FROM trades t CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_array_elements_text(t.sim_metadata->'cluster_wallets') w(addr)
LEFT JOIN wallet_style ws ON ws.address = w.addr
WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.fill_status='closed' AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction' AND json_typeof(t.sim_metadata->'cluster_wallets') = 'array'
  AND json_array_length(t.sim_metadata->'cluster_wallets') > 0 AND $__timeFilter(t.exit_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY attributed_net_usd

panels.description: Each trade's P&L split across its participating wallets, grouped by the wallet's style class (scripts/wallet_style_classify.py). Snipers/MMs are structurally unfollowable.

panels.title: Outcome by buys at entry (time range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT substr(b, 3) AS bucket, count(*) AS n, ROUND(avg((pnl_usd > 0)::int) * 100) AS win_pct,
  ROUND(avg(pnl_usd)::numeric, 1) AS exp_usd, ROUND(sum(pnl_usd)::numeric, 0) AS net_usd
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN '9 ?' WHEN v = 1 THEN '1 1' WHEN v = 2 THEN '2 2' WHEN v <= 5 THEN '3 3-5' WHEN v <= 10 THEN '4 6-10' ELSE '5 >10' END AS b, pnl_usd FROM (SELECT (sim_metadata->>'conviction_n_buys')::int AS v, pnl_usd FROM trades
      WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='conviction' AND $__timeFilter(exit_at)) x) y
GROUP BY b ORDER BY b

WITH o AS (
  SELECT t.id, t.asset, t.entry_at, t.sim_metadata->>'strategy' AS strategy,
    COALESCE(t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet', t.sim_metadata->>'team_id', '') AS who,
    (t.sim_metadata->>'peak_pct_since_entry')::numeric AS peak_pct,
    (t.sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric AS el,
    COALESCE((t.sim_metadata->>'remaining_size_usd')::numeric, t.size_usd::numeric) AS rem,
    t.entry_price::numeric AS ep, l.liquidity_usd::numeric AS liq, l.price::numeric AS px, l.logged_at,
    CASE WHEN l.logged_at IS NULL THEN 'NO DATA'
         WHEN l.liquidity_usd < 100 THEN 'RUG'
         WHEN l.logged_at < now() - interval '2 hours' THEN 'STALE'
         WHEN (t.sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric > 0
              AND l.liquidity_usd < 0.2 * (t.sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric
              THEN 'LIQ COLLAPSED'
         ELSE 'ok' END AS status
  FROM trades t
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT liquidity_usd, price, logged_at FROM position_liquidity_log p
                     WHERE p.trade_id = t.id ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true
  WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.fill_status='open' AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy' IN ('conviction')
), ou AS (
  SELECT o.*, CASE WHEN status='RUG' THEN -rem
                   WHEN px IS NOT NULL AND ep > 0 THEN rem * (px / ep - 1) END AS unreal
  FROM o)
SELECT id, strategy, asset, status, ROUND(rem,0) AS size_usd, ROUND(unreal,0) AS unreal_usd,
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()-entry_at)/3600)::numeric,1) AS held_h,
  ROUND(el,0) AS entry_liq_usd, ROUND(liq,0) AS liq_now_usd,
  ROUND((liq / NULLIF(el,0) - 1) * 100, 0) AS liq_chg_pct,
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()-logged_at)/60)::numeric,0) AS liq_age_min,
  ROUND(peak_pct,1) AS peak_pct, LEFT(who,10) AS trigger, entry_at
FROM ou
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'RUG' THEN 0 WHEN 'LIQ COLLAPSED' THEN 1 WHEN 'STALE' THEN 2
         WHEN 'NO DATA' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, unreal NULLS FIRST

SELECT t.id, t.sim_metadata->>'strategy' AS strategy, t.asset,
  LEFT(COALESCE(t.sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet', t.sim_metadata->>'team_id', ''), 10) AS trigger,
  ROUND(t.size_usd::numeric, 0) AS size_usd, ROUND(t.pnl_usd::numeric, 2) AS pnl_usd, ROUND(t.pnl_pct::numeric, 1) AS pnl_pct,
  t.exit_reason, ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.exit_at - t.entry_at) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS hold_h,
  ROUND((t.sim_metadata->>'token_age_at_entry_hours')::numeric, 2) AS token_age_h,
  ROUND((t.sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric, 0) AS entry_liq_usd, t.entry_at, t.exit_at
FROM trades t WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.fill_status='closed'
  AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy' IN ('conviction') AND $__timeFilter(t.exit_at)
ORDER BY t.exit_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT bot_id, halt_type, severity, halted_at, resumed_at, resumed_by, LEFT(reason, 120) AS reason
FROM halts WHERE bot_id IN ('copy_conviction') AND $__timeFilter(halted_at) ORDER BY halted_at DESC
